integrity: Unrestricted symbolic proof with explicit local-count bijection, closure criterion, and four-color construction; finite exhaustive small-instance checks are corroborating only. Independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact three-named-color census and a sharp 3-versus-4 classification only for connected simple unicyclic graphs with at least one off-cycle vertex. Bare cycles retain previously known 3/4/5-color values. No four-palette optimal assignment count or multicyle classification is claimed. Historical priority is provisional.
title: Modular attachment gaps govern proper conflict-free three-colouring of every unicyclic graph
